basic_profile.bio: A seasoned tech enthusiast with a penchant for building custom PCs. Residing in the Pacific Northwest, enjoys the lush greenery and the vibrant tech scene. Works as a freelance IT consultant, and often helps friends and family with tech-related problems. Enjoys gaming, especially strategy and simulation games, with a soft spot for retro hardware. Usually online in the evenings after 8 PM. In a long-term relationship, and shares a home with a tabby cat named Pixel.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Possesses a deep understanding of computer hardware and software, largely self-taught through years of hands-on experience building and repairing PCs. Regularly keeps up-to-date with the latest technology trends and products through online forums and tech sites. Holds a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, which further solidifies their technical foundation.
